name: Just a Minute of Your Time
source:
Welcome to Wreckminster

Step into the shoes of A.J Raus as the reporter chases the story of a murder on the streets of his dear city, and the profound effects it may have for the future. Explore partnership and community as he and others take you through a short journey into self discovery and what it means to be good!

[From [url=https://ochronoros.itch.io/justaminuteofyourtime]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到残骸明斯特

扮演A.J Raus的记者，追踪发生在他亲爱的城市街道上的谋杀案，以及这起谋杀案可能对未来产生的深远影响。探索合作伙伴关系和社区，他和其他人将带你经历一段自我发现的短途旅程，以及什么是优秀！

[来自[url=https://ochronoros.itch.io/justaminuteofyourtime]Itch.io[/url]]
